basic_details.short_information: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur has advertised 2 Physiotherapist posts (1 male, 1 female), and applications go by email to [email protected] on or before 5 December 2026. The email subject must be "Application for Physiotherapist". Advertisement No. MGUG/Recruitment/2026/11/003 is dated 19 November 2026.

qualification.details: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) degree from a recognized University/Institution. Valid registration with the State Council. Sound knowledge of physiotherapy assessment techniques, treatment protocols and rehabilitation procedures. Ability to assess patients with musculoskeletal, neurological, orthopaedic and other physical rehabilitation needs. Knowledge of therapeutic exercises, manual therapy techniques and electrotherapy modalities. Ability to develop and implement individualized physiotherapy treatment plans. | Master of Physiotherapy (MPT). Experience in a hospital, rehabilitation centre or healthcare institution. Experience in managing patients in OPD, IPD and post-operative rehabilitation settings. Knowledge of patient documentation, treatment records and progress assessment. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

selection_process: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The notice does not describe the shortlisting method or what the interview covers.

content_sections.heading: About Mahayogi Gorakhnath University
content_sections.text: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur describes itself as a multidisciplinary university expanding across a 200+ acre campus at Balapar, Gorakhpur. Its fields include Medicine, Ayurveda, Pharmacy, Nursing, Agriculture, Health and Life Science, Engineering and Technology, Allied and Healthcare, and Management and Commerce. The notice also mentions an upcoming multi-specialty hospital with 1,800 beds, and two functional hospitals at Gorakhpur: Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (650+ beds) and Mahayogi Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (300+ beds). The University is at Arogya Dham, Balapar Road, Sonbarsa, Gorakhpur-273007.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may send their detailed resume along with supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 5 December 2026. The notice does not say whether this date is for receipt or dispatch. Email address: [email protected] Subject of email: Application for Physiotherapist Attach: detailed resume and supporting documents The notice names no separate application form and gives no postal address for applications.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) degree from a recognized University/Institution. Valid registration with the State Council. Sound knowledge of physiotherapy assessment techniques, treatment protocols and rehabilitation procedures. Ability to assess patients with musculoskeletal, neurological, orthopaedic and other physical rehabilitation needs. Knowledge of therapeutic exercises, manual therapy techniques and electrotherapy modalities. Ability to develop and implement individualized physiotherapy treatment plans. Master of Physiotherapy (MPT). Experience in a hospital, rehabilitation centre or healthcare institution. Experience in managing patients in OPD, IPD and post-operative rehabilitation settings. Knowledge of patient documentation, treatment records and progress assessment. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many Physiotherapist posts has MGUG advertised?
faq.answer: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur has advertised 2 Physiotherapist posts: 1 for a male and 1 for a female candidate.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MGUG Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the MGUG Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) degree from a recognized University/Institution and valid registration with the State Council are essential.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for the MGUG Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: Send your detailed resume with supporting documents by email to [email protected] on or before 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What subject line should the application email carry?
faq.answer: The subject of the email should be "Application for Physiotherapist".

faq.question: Q6. How are candidates selected for the MGUG Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the MGUG Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: The notice says salary shall be commensurate with qualification, skills and experience as per University rules. It prints no amount.

faq.question: Q8. Are the posts open to both men and women?
faq.answer: Yes. Of the 2 posts, 1 is for a male and 1 is for a female candidate.

faq.question: Q9. Is an MPT degree compulsory?
faq.answer: No. Master of Physiotherapy (MPT) is listed under desirable qualifications. The essential qualification is the BPT degree with State Council registration.

faq.question: Q10. Can the University cancel the recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all the posts, and to withdraw the advertisement partly or wholly at any time without assigning any reason.
